thread.title: U.S. stocks end higher, but trim gains as energy rally fades

author: Ryan Vlastelica
title: U.S. stocks end higher, but trim gains as energy rally fades
text: U.S. stocks closed higher on Monday, but major indexes ended well off their highs as an early rally in energy stocks faded. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.39% rose 0.4% to 24,355. The S&P 500 SPX, +0.35% gained 0.3% to 2,673. The Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, +0.77% rose 0.8% to 7,265. Both the S&P and the Nasdaq posted their second straight daily gain, while the Dow extended its winning streak to a third, including a rise of 0.02% on Thursday. Technology stocks were among the strongest of the day, with the sector up 0.8%. Among notable names, Microsoft Corp. MSFT, +1.12% rose 1.1% and Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.71% was up 0.7%. Energy stocks rose 0.2%, ending well below an early rally that took the industry up more than 2%. The sector's rise faded after President Trump tweeted he would make an announcement on a possible decertification of the Iran nuclear agreement.
